mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `group` (platform, bot_id, group_id, group_name, lifecycle, in_service) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{groupName}, 'DISCOVERED', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_name = IF(VALUES (group_name) IS NOT NULL, VALUES (group_name), group_name)
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, group_name AS groupName, lifecycle, in_service AS inService, paused_at AS pausedAt, paused_accumulated_millis AS pausedAccumulatedMillis, discovered_at AS discoveredAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM `group` WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
